label: Objective truth has a truth component: HasTruthComponent f means ∀ s, objective s → holds actual s
term: objective truth has a truth component
definition: HasTruthComponent f means ∀ s, objective s → holds actual s. It is only the forward truth-component condition, not a complete definition.
note: This openly stipulated bridge is exactly the extra premise needed to carry the old external-emotivism denial of truth to denial of objective truth. It does not select actual-stable, robust, minimal or any other complete truth account.
